summary: Frontend-only test of Sky Sync name onboarding + dynamic greeting feature. All 9 requested test scenarios passed end-to-end via Playwright against the live preview URL.
tests_executed: Fresh user: localStorage cleared + reload -> [data-testid=name-onboarding] modal appears with 'Welcome to Sky Sync' and 'What should we call you?' copy. Input + Continue button present.
Continue button disabled when input empty; enabled after typing 'Rahul'.
Submitting 'Rahul' closes modal, persists localStorage.mausam-user-name='Rahul'. Persona onboarding then skipped.
welcome-greeting mapped to current browser hour (14 -> 'Good afternoon, Rahul 👋').
Reload persistence: modal not shown again; greeting still 'Good afternoon, Rahul 👋'.
Profile popover: profile-name-display shows 'Rahul'. Renaming to 'Meera' updates welcome-greeting to '... Meera 👋', hero greeting, avatar to 'M', and localStorage to 'Meera' (all reactive).
Empty profile-name-input -> profile-name-display shows 'Set your name'.
Regression: data-atmosphere present on hero; no horizontal overflow at 390x844 mobile; 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is nearly 1000 lines - consider splitting Hero, NamePrompt, ProfilePanel into /components for maintainability.
greeting is memoized on [tick] which is fine; make sure the tick interval is cleared on unmount (verify useEffect cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Name onboarding flow, greeting mapping, avatar, persistence, and rename-from-profile all confirmed working. Test-ids in use: name-onboarding, name-onboarding-input, name-onboarding-continue, welcome-greeting, profile-button, profile-panel, profile-avatar, profile-name-display, profile-name-input, hero-weather-card. Browser hour at test time was 14 (afternoon) - other time slots not exercised at runtime but greetingFor() logic is straightforward mapping (5-11 morning, 12-16 afternoon, 17-20 evening, 21-4 night).
